question: Which divisions have a total outward taxable value above 10000000?
gold_sql: SELECT j.division FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b r JOIN common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d ON d.gstin = r.gstin JOIN common.mst_state_jurisdiction_code j ON j.state_jur_code = d.stjd JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details s ON s.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b = r.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details_osupdet o ON o.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details = s.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details GROUP BY j.division HAVING SUM(o.txval) > 10000000;

question: Which taxpayers filed in more than 5 distinct return periods?
gold_sql: SELECT r.gstin FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b r GROUP BY r.gstin HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.ret_period) > 5;

question: Which deductors filed GSTR-7 returns in more than one return period?
gold_sql: SELECT gstin FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7 GROUP BY gstin HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fp) > 1;

question: Which return periods have a total TDS above 300000?
gold_sql: SELECT r.fp FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7 r JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds t ON t.tbl_gst_rtn_r7 = r.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7 GROUP BY r.fp HAVING SUM(t.iamt + t.camt + t.samt) > 300000;

question: What is the average TDS deducted (IGST+CGST+SGST) per deductor?
gold_sql: SELECT r.gstin, AVG(t.iamt + t.camt + t.samt) AS v FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7 r JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds t ON t.tbl_gst_rtn_r7 = r.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7 GROUP BY r.gstin;

question: For each deductor, what is the total TDS deducted (IGST+CGST+SGST) from each of their deductees?
gold_sql: SELECT r.gstin, t.gstin_ded, SUM(t.iamt + t.camt + t.samt) AS v FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7 r JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds t ON t.tbl_gst_rtn_r7 = r.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7 GROUP BY r.gstin, t.gstin_ded;

question: How many taxpayers have a proprietorship (PRO) constitution of business?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d WHERE d.cobz = 'PRO';

question: What is the trade name of the taxpayer with GSTIN 24AAAAR0001A9AA?
gold_sql: SELECT d.trdnm FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d WHERE d.gstin = '24AAAAR0001A9AA';

question: What are the range and unit for the taxpayer Surat Textiles Pvt Ltd?
gold_sql: SELECT j."range", j.unit FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d JOIN common.mst_state_jurisdiction_code j ON j.state_jur_code = d.stjd WHERE d.trdnm ILIKE '%Surat Textiles%';

question: How many taxpayers are there in each jurisdiction range?
gold_sql: SELECT j."range", COUNT(*) AS n FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d JOIN common.mst_state_jurisdiction_code j ON j.state_jur_code = d.stjd GROUP BY j."range";

question: How many taxpayers fall under each risk profile?
gold_sql: SELECT d.risk_profile, COUNT(*) AS n FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d GROUP BY d.risk_profile;

question: How many taxpayers are registered under CENTER approving authority?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d WHERE d.appr_auth = 'CENTER';

question: List the trade names of taxpayers whose registration has been cancelled.
gold_sql: SELECT d.trdnm FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d WHERE d.canc_dt IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.trdnm;

question: How many taxpayers are in the division named Division 2 (ABD)?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d JOIN common.mst_state_jurisdiction_code j ON j.state_jur_code = d.stjd WHERE j.division = 'Division 2 (ABD)';

question: List the trade names of taxpayers with a low risk profile under STATE approving authority.
gold_sql: SELECT d.trdnm FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d WHERE d.risk_profile ILIKE 'LOW%' AND d.appr_auth = 'STATE' ORDER BY d.trdnm;

question: What is the total outward taxable value filed by taxpayers located in Division 3 (ABD)?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(o.txval) AS v FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b r JOIN common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d ON d.gstin = r.gstin JOIN common.mst_state_jurisdiction_code j ON j.state_jur_code = d.stjd JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details s ON s.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b = r.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details_osupdet o ON o.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details = s.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details WHERE j.division = 'Division 3 (ABD)';

question: What is the constitution of business of the taxpayer Gujarat Pharma Corp?
gold_sql: SELECT d.cobz FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d WHERE d.trdnm ILIKE '%Gujarat Pharma%';

question: Which jurisdiction divisions have more than 2 registered taxpayers?
gold_sql: SELECT j.division FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d JOIN common.mst_state_jurisdiction_code j ON j.state_jur_code = d.stjd GROUP BY j.division HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;
